phDonutHint: Based on health set in project settings
phBarChartLatestNote: Showing the latest updated {{count}} projects in this graph. Select all projects to show every project.
phCalcOnTrack: Count of selected projects whose health is set to Good in project settings.
phCalcAtRisk: Count of selected projects whose health is set to At Risk in project settings.
phCalcOffTrack: Count of selected projects whose health is set to Needs Attention in project settings.
phCalcOverdueTasks: Sum of incomplete, non-archived tasks past their due date across all selected projects.
phCalcHealthStatus: Distribution of selected projects by health setting: Good (On track), At Risk, Needs Attention (Off track), or Not set.
phCalcProgressBudget: Progress % = completed tasks ÷ total tasks. Budget used % = (task fixed costs + logged time cost) ÷ project budget.
phCalcColHealth: Project health from settings: Good → On track, At Risk → At risk, Needs Attention → Off track.
phCalcColOpenTasks: Incomplete, non-archived tasks in the project.
phCalcColOverdue: Incomplete, non-archived tasks whose due date is before today.
phCalcColBudgetUsed: (Task fixed costs + logged time cost) ÷ project budget × 100. Shown as — when budget is 0.
phNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects (or a team) to view project health.
pvaTasksNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects (or a team) to compare planned vs actual tasks.
pvaMsNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects with the Filter button above to compare planned vs actual milestone dates.
utilChartEmpty: No team members match these filters.
utilNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects (or a team) to view capacity vs logged time.
trChartEmpty: No time data matches these filters.
trNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects (or a team) to view logged vs estimated hours.
btChartEmpty: No budget data matches these filters.
btNoSelectionDescription: Choose one or more projects (or a team) to view budget spent vs remaining.
velCalcAvg: Average completed work per sprint/phase: sum of completed points (or tasks) ÷ number of completed buckets.
velCalcLast: Completed work in the most recent completed sprint or phase.
velCalcCommitment: Average of (completed ÷ committed) × 100 across completed sprints/phases with a commitment.
velCalcCount: Number of completed sprints or phases included in this report.
btCalcTotalBudget: Sum of project budgets for all selected projects that have a budget set.
btCalcSpent: Sum of task fixed costs plus logged time cost (hours × rate) across selected projects.
btCalcRemaining: Total budget − spent. Negative means overall spend exceeds budget.
btCalcOverBudget: Number of selected projects where spent is greater than the project budget.
trCalcLogged: Sum of time-log entries (hours) for selected projects in the date range.
trCalcEstimated: Sum of planned/estimated hours on tasks in the selected projects.
trCalcBillable: Logged hours marked billable. Percentage = billable hours ÷ logged hours × 100.
trCalcOverEstimate: Max(0, logged hours − estimated hours) across the selection.
utilCalcAvg: Total logged hours ÷ total capacity hours × 100 across selected members/projects.
utilCalcTeamSize: Number of distinct team members included in the utilization selection.
utilCalcOver: Members whose logged hours exceed 100% of their capacity.
utilCalcUnder: Members whose utilization is at or below 80% of capacity.
pvaMsCalcMilestones: Count of milestones (phases) in the selected project(s).
pvaMsCalcLate: Milestones whose actual end (or today if still open) is after the planned date.
pvaMsCalcOnTime: Milestones completed on or before the planned date (or still on track if not due).
pvaMsCalcAvgSlip: Average days late vs planned dates across milestones (positive = behind plan).
pvaTkCalcPlanned: Count of tasks with a planned/due date in the selected project(s).
pvaTkCalcCompleted: Completed tasks in the selection. Percentage = completed ÷ planned × 100.
pvaTkCalcOverdue: Incomplete tasks past their due date, plus completed tasks finished after the due date.
pvaTkCalcAvgVariance: Average days between actual/completed date and planned due date (positive = late).
cfdCalcWip: Count of tasks currently in In Progress (doing) statuses at the end of the selected period.
cfdCalcThroughput: Average tasks completed per day in the selected date range (done-status entries ÷ days).
cfdCalcCycle: Average days from when work started (entered doing) to when the task was completed.
cfdCalcLead: Average days from task creation to completion (includes waiting time).
tisCalcIssues: Number of tasks with status history included in this report.
tisCalcVisits: Total times tasks entered a status (one task can visit multiple statuses).
tisCalcAvgCycle: Sum of average days spent in each status — an estimate of overall cycle time.
tisCalcOutliers: Tasks whose time in a status is unusually high compared with peers (statistical outliers).
